description: "The Cause and Cure of the Cattle Plague: A Plain Sermon" by James Galloway Cowan is a religious sermon published in the mid-19th century, specifically in 1866. This book falls under the category of a religious or theological work, exploring the intersection of faith and the natural calamities that impact livestock.
